title: 1988 Donruss Diamond #14 Kal Daniels Cincinnati Reds Baseball Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: This is a 1988 Donruss Diamond Kings trading card featuring Kal Daniels of the Cincinnati Reds. The card is an original vintage piece made of card stock in the United States. It is part of the Diamond Kings subset in the 1988 Donruss set, showcasing artwork of the player. The card is in standard size and is a Major League Baseball (MLB) licensed product.
